Here is the verbatim transcription and analysis of the three crops: ### **Crop 1: Top Header (Browser/Status Bar)** | Text Element | Color | Visual Problems / Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **24 min** | Bright Green | None. | | **71** | White (on black battery icon) | Battery icon appears partially cut off on the right edge. | | **italiano-master.vercel.app** | Black | This is the URL bar text. No visual issues. | --- ### **Crop 2: Greeting Section** | Text Element | Color | Visual Problems / Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Benvenuto!** | White | Standard Italian greeting ("Welcome" - masculine singular). Correct for the context. | | **LMS COMPLETO · DA ZERO A C2** | Green (on dark outline) | "LMS" is an English acronym (Learning Management System). The rest is Italian ("Complete LMS · From Zero to C2"). No visual errors. | | **Ciao Studente,** | White (Serif font) | Italian greeting. Correct grammar. | | **impariamo l'italiano.** | Light Green (Italic Serif font) | Italian phrase meaning "let's learn Italian." Correct grammar. | --- ### **Crop 3: Description & Action Button Area** | Text Element | Color | Visual Problems / Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **impariamo l'italiano.** | Light Green (Italic) | Continuation of the heading from Crop 2. Appears correctly. | | **Un sistema integral: lecciones conectadas, las 4 destrezas, gramática paso a paso, pronunciación interactiva, repaso espaciado, tutor IA y certificados.** | Light Grey | **Major Language Error:** This paragraph is in **Spanish**, not Italian.
• *integral* should be Italian *integrale*
• *lecciones* → *lezioni*
• *las 4 destrezas* → *le 4 abilità*
• *paso a passo* → *passo dopo passo*
• *pronunciación* → *pronuncia*
• *repaso espaciado* → *ripetizione dilazionata*
• *tutor IA* → *tutor IA* (acceptable) or *tutore AI*
• *certificados* → *certificati* | | ***La tua strada verso il dominio.* | Italicized Light Grey | **Language Inconsistency:** This closing phrase is correctly in **Italian** ("Your path towards mastery"), but it follows a Spanish paragraph, creating a jarring code-switching error for the user. | | **Continúa: Idiomaticidad y regionalismos** | White (on Green button) | **Mixed Language Error:**
• *Continúa* is **Spanish** (Italian would be *Continua*).
• *Idiomaticidad* is **Spanish** (Italian would be *Idiomaticità* or *Espressioni idiomatiche*).
• *regionalismos* is **Spanish** (Italian would be *regionalismi*).
The button tells a Spanish speaker to continue to a lesson using Spanish terminology, despite the app being for learning Italian. | ### **Summary of Visual & Content Issues** 1. **Grammar/Language Mixing (Critical):** The app mixes Spanish and Italian. The main description body is entirely in Spanish, while the greetings and final slogan are in Italian. 2. **Button Text Error:** The action button uses Spanish verb conjugation (*Continúa*) and vocabulary (*Idiomaticidad*) instead of Italian. 3. **Visual Cut-off:** The battery percentage icon (`71`) is slightly truncated at the right edge of the screen in the first crop.
